meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划拆成多路并行执行,并留下可核对的证据记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果已把开发计划写成文档,想让它自动并行跑完并留下执行痕迹
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan in parallel tracks and leave an evidence trail you can check
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your dev plan is already written down and you want it executed in parallel with a traceable record

howto.what: Claude 变成只做编排的角色:自己不动手写代码、不改产品文件、不亲自跑 QA,把实现、测试、QA、评审都派给并行的子代理,按 .omo/plans 里的工作计划逐个勾选框推进,并记录 Boulder 状态、证据账本和各阶段工作树。
howto.when: 当你说出 “ulw-execute”,或要求运行 .omo/plans 目录下的某个工作计划时接管。若当期没有可用计划,它会先调用 ulw-plan 生成计划再执行。

say.note: 选中 .omo/plans 下的计划并开始执行
每阶段开 PR 并盯到合并后再清理工作树

say.text: 用 --make-pr 执行,每个阶段出一个 PR
say.note: 各阶段工作树各自作为 PR 交付

howto.what_en: Claude acts only as an orchestrator, never writing code or editing product files itself: it delegates implementation, tests, QA and review to parallel subagents and works through the checkboxes of a plan under .omo/plans.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you say "ulw-execute" or ask to run a work plan under .omo/plans. If no plan is selectable, it bootstraps ulw-plan first.

say_en.note: picks the plan under .omo/plans and starts
opens PRs and stays until merged

say_en.text: execute with --make-pr, one PR per phase
say_en.note: each phase worktree ships as its own PR
